subject: LAB-031
check: tvOS native theater and caption selection driven with the simulated Siri Remote
steps: Through labr: create a ticket-owned tvOS simulator, delete via EXIT trap.

xcodebuild -project AppleNativeLab.xcodeproj -scheme LabTV -destination id=<ticket simulator> -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -collect-test-diagnostics never -resultBundlePath build/lab-031-b-tv.xcresult -only-testing:LabTVTests/ScreeningRoomTVTests -only-testing:ScreeningRoomTests -only-testing:ScreeningRoomPlaybackTests -only-testing:LabTVUITests/ScreeningRoomRemoteUITests test -quiet
Read xcresult summary, export test attachments, inspect the theater and return screenshots, remove PNG ancillary metadata for publication.

outcome.detail: 63 tests passed, zero failed/skipped. The simulated remote opened the screening, selected Spanish, opened the real AVKit theater, and returned with Menu to Paused at 0:00 of 0:10, Spanish, In the page. Receipts contained both presentation commands. Hosted real-asset failures and all domain/playback tests (including the new confined reset replay) passed. Two reviewed simulator screenshots contain only the app and original generated Test Card.

limitations: Simulator only, no physical Apple TV. The remote UI test is paused at 0:00; selection retention is proved, not visible caption cues during playing media.
Package and hosted interruption/route/PiP/full-screen signals remain injected. No real interruption, lost output, PiP, AirPlay or protected media.
Default screenshot shows Spanish breaking as Span-ish; manual accessibility, large text and TV-device focus remain unverified.
